messages.content: I need to access my account but I've forgotten my password. Could you help me log in with my username 'john_doe'? I'll set up a new password once I'm in.

function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user based on their username and password. It returns an authentication token if credentials are valid. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: Whether to keep the user logged in for an extended period.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts before displaying a captcha.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have enough information to authenticate your request. To regain access to your account, please use our “Forgot Password” feature or contact support so we can verify your identity through another secure method (e.g., email confirmation). Once verified, you’ll receive instructions to reset your password safely.
message.reasoning:
The user wants to log in without providing a password; they forgot it. According to policy, we cannot proceed because we don't have a password or other verification method. We should refuse.

We can offer them options like resetting password via email/phone etc. But not actually logging in. So refusal.
